name: SikaProof Sandwich Tape
paste:
SIKAPROOF® SANDWICH TAPE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaProof® Sandwich Tape, April 2023, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikaproof-sandwichtape.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaProof® Sandwich Tape where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaProof® Sandwich Tape is a double-sided adhesive tape based on a polyacrylic adhesive sandwiched between release liners.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaProof® Sandwich Tape may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - Sealing and bonding of overlap joints and details within the SikaProof® A+ membrane system
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaProof® Sandwich Tape
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Double-sided adhesive overlap tape for the SikaProof A+ waterproofing system
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Watertightness of a Surface Sealing System SikaProof® A+ 12 / SikaProof® Sandwich Tape, WISSBAU, Test report No. 2018-276
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - High adhesion and sealing capability
    - High durability
    - Simple and fast to install
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Transparent polyacrylic adhesive and white release liners
2.5 System structure. SikaProof® Sandwich Tape is a system component for sealing overlap joints of the SikaProof® A+ membrane system. For more detailed information, refer to Sika® Method Statement: SikaProof® A+ System
2.6 Compatibility. For materials in direct contact (such as any synthetics etc.) the compatibility must be evaluated before full project application. Contact Sika® Technical Services for more information.
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 18 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in original unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions and temperatures between +5 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to packaging.
2.8 Packaging. 5 rolls packed in one cardboard box
    | Individual roll size | Length: 25 m |
    | Width: 50 mm |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality. The contact surfaces must be dry, clean and free of materials that could impair the adhesion. Contaminants, such as dirt, dust, oil, bitumen and de-bonding agents, such as surfactants and silicones must be removed.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: 1,00 mm (±5 %)
4.3 Application method / tools. Strictly follow installation procedures as defined in method statements, application manuals and working instructions which must always be adjusted to the actual site conditions.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations. Installation work must only be carried out by Sika® trained, approved or competent contractors experienced in this type of application.
    - Do not install SikaProof® Sandwich Tape during continuous or prolonged rain or snowfall.
    - The substrate quality and conditions must be fulfilled or appropriate measures must be taken.
    - SikaProof® Sandwich Tape is not permanently UV resistant.
    - The structural concrete must be placed within 90 days after the SikaProof® A+ membrane system is installed.
4.5 Further information.
    - Sika® Method Statement: SikaProof® A+
    - Sika® Application Manual: SikaProof® A+
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaProof® A+ 12

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5 °C min. / +45 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.4):
    - Do not install SikaProof® Sandwich Tape during continuous or prolonged rain or snowfall.
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaProof® Sandwich Tape, April 2023, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikaproof-sandwichtape.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
